items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And Will Mastin, who is the uncle of Sammy, the Will Mastin Trio?

ctx.x: I didn't know that. That was before me. I don't know that. Not before my time, but I don't know about that. But I want to make it plain. So anytime any of the performers get a letter from me, it's just that I'm inquiring about them because I would like to hear from them. And Will Mastin, who is the uncle of Sammy, the Will Mastin Trio?
